integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic nature-documentary style, an eye-level medium shot opens exactly on the composition of <Picture 1>: a milk frog with tan-brown banded, white-speckled skin and large dark cross-pupiled eyes perched on a blue-grey marbled stone, its mirror reflection filling the lower half of the frame against a uniform muted green backdrop. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward a close-up of the frog's head, its large bright eyes and brown-and-white patterned skin blending tonally with the stone and green surroundings while the frog stays still and the reflection remains sharp. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera pulls back and tracks the frog as it suddenly leaps off the stone in a smooth arc toward one side; the stone and the frog's crisp reflection stay visible on the still water like a mirror revealing another world, and a soft splash sounds at takeoff. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the frog lands on the water surface and concentric ripples spread outward, briefly distorting the reflection; the camera zooms in with small amplitude at slow speed to highlight the frog's graceful, elegant paddling motion with its front limbs, small wake trails trailing behind as its head and eyes stay above the surface. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the frog jumps again and the camera pulls back to a wider framing, revealing the frog mid-leap against the flat green backdrop, its patterned body reading like a dynamic oil painting; ripples settle, the reflection reforms, and the shot holds as the frog lands with a final splash.

overall_soundscape: Gentle water laps steadily throughout, punctuated by the soft splash of the frog's takeoff, a second splash as it lands and paddles, and a final leap splash. Distant birdsong drifts from the forest, with an occasional low frog croak near the beginning and again at the end.
